arguments.cmd:
cd /tmp/rotonly && python - <<'EOF'
src = open('model.scad').read()
old = '''    echo(cadverify_spec = [
        ["bounds", [[0, 0, 0], [30, 25, 12.5]]],'''
new = '''    echo(cadverify_spec = [
        ["bounds", [[0, 0, 0], [30, 41, 12.5]]],'''
assert src.count(old)==1
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('model.scad','w').write(src)
print("ok")
EOF
timeout 280 cadcheck behaviour --out-dir /tmp/rotonly/bout model.scad 2>&1 | python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d, indent=1)[:5000])"
